source_title: E127: a truly capable Formal AI: coding by discovery over the formalized internet, every LLM task class in formal form, fact checking with relative meta logic, self-coding via Hive Mind, dependencies latest and deduplicated (sub-issues)

E148: white-box derivation for every answer: derivation_id on every answer, a durable derivation record, and formal-ai explain <answer-id>

E143: creative writing, brainstorming, planning and advice as constraint-based composition from formalized sources

Bulk QA, reasoning and coding fixes; recursive meta reasoner; JS server parity
